whySelected: The current InstantMesh path independently generates front/right/back candidates, so their geometry is not a single multi-view-consistent reconstruction.
Wonder3D explicitly generates consistent multi-view normal and color images before mesh fusion.
The official repository describes a free MIT-licensed codebase and an inference path using one GPU.
constraints: Official inference resizes inputs to 256x256 and supports six generated views.
The official setup requires the Wonder3D dependencies and NVlabs tiny-cuda-nn.
Exact Tesla T4 memory behavior is not verified; no Colab generation was run in this preparation step.
Checkpoint terms must be checked separately before commercial redistribution.
Face landmarks, equipment sockets, rigging, and production topology remain blocked even if the candidate scores higher.

plannedCommands.meshExtractionPreferred: cd instant-nsr-pl && python launch.py --config configs/neuralangelo-ortho-wmask.yaml --gpu 0 --train dataset.root_dir=../{wonder3d_output}/cropsize-192-cfg1.0/ dataset.scene=CH101_front

evaluationPlan: Verify provider checkout commit and reference front SHA256.
Generate six RGB/normal views without changing the production gates.
Extract one mesh with NeuS if Instant-NSR dependency or memory is unsuitable.
Convert or copy the extracted mesh into the generic candidate intake format.
Run Blender refinement, evaluation, score, and ranking with unityInputAllowed=false.
Record all dependency, CUDA, output, SHA256, and score results even on failure.

alternativesNotSelected.hunyuan3d2_1: Official repository reports 10 GB VRAM for shape, 21 GB for texture, and 29 GB combined; it is not a safe T4 textured path and remains excluded by the South Korea workflow policy.
alternativesNotSelected.trellis: Official TRELLIS is image-to-3D but is not a true multi-view input path for this contract; its full CUDA setup will be evaluated only if Wonder3D is unsuitable.
alternativesNotSelected.trellisCpp: Native C++ can reduce Python dependency friction, but it is still a separate TRELLIS.2 single-image path and requires a supported local GPU/runtime; it is not the immediate multi-view experiment.

nextAction: Run one Wonder3D T4 experiment only when a fresh Colab GPU runtime is available; do not connect the result to Unity automatically.
